title: Numbers 19:9-10 — ashes gathered by a clean man, stored outside the camp
summary: Numbers 19:9-10 in English: a clean man gathers the heifer's ashes and stores them in a clean place outside the camp for the water of purification, and the gatherer washes his clothes and is unclean until evening. Key words (clean, ashes, heifer, water, unclean) are colour-coded; the 'el' in Israel is highlighted in two colours.

text.text: 9 ‘Then a man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and store them outside the camp in a clean place; and they shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for the water of purification; it is for purifying from sin.

10 ‘The one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening; and it shall be a perpetual statute to the sons of Israel and to the alien who sojourns among them.
